SOFTWARE-AS-A-SERVICE AGREEMENT

This Software-as-a-Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into between Acme
SaaS Pvt. Ltd., a company incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware
("Provider"), and the customer identified in the Order Form ("Customer"). This
Agreement is effective on the date signed by both parties.

1. SERVICES

Provider grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to access
the cloud-based software services (the "Services") described in the Order Form,
solely for Customer's internal business operations. All Customer Data and any
intellectual property created during use of the Services shall be assigned to
Provider on creation, including derivative works.

2. TERM AND TERMINATION

The initial term is twelve (12) months, commencing on the Effective Date. This
Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one (1) year periods unless
either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days
prior to the end of the then-current term. The Provider may terminate this
Agreement at any time without cause and without notice. Customer may terminate
only for material breach by Provider that remains uncured after thirty (30) days
written notice.

3. FEES AND PAYMENT

Customer shall pay all Fees as set forth in the Order Form. Invoices are due
upon receipt. Any unpaid amounts shall accrue interest at the rate of three
percent (3%) per month or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is
higher. Customer waives any right to dispute invoices.

4. LIABILITY

EXCEPT FOR CUSTOMER'S PAYMENT OBLIGATIONS, EACH PARTY'S LIABILITY UNDER THIS
AGREEMENT IS UNLIMITED. Provider shall not be liable for indirect, incidental,
or consequential damages, but Customer shall remain liable without limit of
liability for any breach. Customer shall indemnify and hold harmless Provider,
its affiliates, officers, directors, and employees from any and all claims,
losses, damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees)
arising out of or related to Customer's use of the Services, including without
limitation claims by third parties.

5. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

Customer hereby assigns to Provider all right, title, and interest in any
feedback, suggestions, ideas, or improvements relating to the Services,
including all intellectual property rights therein, in perpetuity and
worldwide, without compensation.

6. CONFIDENTIALITY

Each party agrees to keep Confidential Information strictly confidential in
perpetuity. The receiving party shall not disclose Confidential Information to
any third party under any circumstances, with no exceptions for legally
compelled disclosures or court orders.

7. NON-COMPETE

During the term of this Agreement and for a period of three (3) years after
termination, Customer shall not, directly or indirectly, engage in any business
that competes with Provider, nor solicit any of Provider's employees or
contractors.

8. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws
of the Cayman Islands, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. Any
dispute arising under this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive
jurisdiction of the courts of the Cayman Islands.

9. DATA AND SECURITY

Provider may use, process, and disclose Customer Data for any purpose at its
sole discretion. Provider makes no representation regarding security standards,
breach notification, or data protection compliance.

10. ASSIGNMENT

Customer shall not assign this Agreement without Provider's prior written
consent. Provider may assign this Agreement at any time to any third party
without notice to Customer.

11. ENTIRE AGREEMENT

This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and
supersedes all prior agreements. No modifications are valid unless in writing
signed by both parties.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the
Effective Date.

PROVIDER: Acme SaaS Pvt. Ltd.
By: ____________________________

CUSTOMER:
